description: This file defines a PHP class 'Cotangent' within the PhpSpreadsheet library that provides mathematical functions related to trigonometry, including cotangent, hyperbolic cotangent, arccotangent, and hyperbolic arccotangent. The class is designed to handle scalar values and arrays, facilitating calculations in spreadsheet environments.

classes.name: Cotangent
classes.description: Provides trigonometric and hyperbolic cotangent functions, as well as their inverse functions, supporting array and scalar inputs within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

methods.name: cot
methods.description: Calculates the cotangent of an angle, handling both scalar and array inputs; delegates to helper functions for validation and evaluation.

methods.name: coth
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic cotangent of an angle, handling both scalar and array inputs.

methods.name: acot
methods.description: Calculates the arccotangent (inverse cotangent) of a number, handling both scalar and array inputs.

methods.name: acoth
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic arccotangent of a number, handling both scalar and array inputs.
